message: border-radius isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android (3 places)
hint: Round corners can be used in VML with the `RoundRect` element. See the [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/msdn-online-vml-roundrect-element).
Negative margins on flex and grid items are never lowered: space the items with gap or padding, or for an overlap (an avatar stack) use a single pre-composed image.
